parole.significato: A unit of volume equivalent to around 375 mL.
parole.testo: From Philippine Spanish chupa, probably from Malay cupak.

parole.significato: A gold-copper alloy used by the pre-Columbian cultures of Central America to make religious objects.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Spanish tumbaga, from Malay tembaga, from Sanskrit ताम्रक (tāmraka). Doublet of tombak.
